scope: Current-catalog fenced enrollment, synchronous policy acknowledgement, exact outcome resolution, protected trust and bounded SQL admission; local engineering qualification.
parentAcceptance: open; integrated O03.6.3 qualification and parent review remain required

acceptance.criterion: Inventory every supported authority mutation and all current eligibility/lifecycle inputs. Under a fenced closed maintenance window export complete current authority, tombstones, immutable historical event identity and credentials/leases without secrets; unsupported nondefault state and producer versions fail closed.
acceptance.evidence: Closed maintenance enrollment captures all current authority, ended/revoked state, installation/schema identity, immutable history and redacted credential/lease status. Existing runtime SQL identities are retired and cannot be regranted. Integration tests exercise complete enrollment, unsupported eligibility/lifecycle/history, size refusal, lost enrollment response and historical v1 continuity.

acceptance.criterion: Add an additive schema and trusted adapter at PolicySql.commit: bounded verified PREPARE precedes any visible local commit; effects, invalidations, event and pending receipt commit atomically; verified remote COMMIT precedes completed success. Preserve old migration and historical event bytes.
acceptance.evidence: Additive V010 plus PolicySql.commit and the connection-owned transaction strategy implement bounded verified PREPARE, atomic effects/event/Pending receipt, and verified COMMIT before success. The nineteen supported mutation kinds are exercised against real PostgreSQL and TLS witness; old migrations and original scientific implementation/history remain unchanged.

acceptance.criterion: Reconcile ambiguous local/remote outcomes under the live catalog exclusive guard by exact operation ID and payload. Explicit ABORT requires proven live absence; restored backup absence never authorizes it. Pending restrictions apply locally, no write overtakes them, and credential issuance never duplicates a lost-response operation.
acceptance.evidence: Observed failures include lost PREPARE acknowledgement, local COMMIT response loss, lost remote COMMIT acknowledgement, live event-insert rollback/ABORT, pending restrictive revocation, no overtaking and retained credential issuance retries. Resolution uses exact event/payload under a live exclusive lock; restarted absence stays closed.

acceptance.criterion: Integrate independently retained trust with service/operator configuration and least-privilege roles. Startup and every runtime admission validate installation, epoch and heads with permits no longer than five seconds and bounded drain; barrier fencing must stop the old service independently of restored database fields.
acceptance.evidence: Protected writer/recovery configuration, pinned signing public key, fresh CURRENT admission, five-second transaction permits and bounded acknowledgement/abort phases are integrated. Tests prove running-service barrier refusal with unchanged local epoch, expired connection eviction, stale head/missing trust refusal, old SQL identity retirement and fresh least-privilege runtime mutation.

acceptance.criterion: Return explicit pending/outcome-unknown/durably acknowledged status and redacted readiness. Test actual supported mutation classes, current local authorization, unsupported capability refusal and failed event rollback. Keep organization restore blocked pending O03.7/O03.8.
acceptance.evidence: Organization receipts, credential results and HTTP grant/revoke headers explicitly distinguish LocalOnly/Durable; pending and unknown errors carry separate operation codes. Real HTTP failure tests and packaged CLI/API checks verify those outcomes. Redacted readiness, a complete operator guide and unchanged legacy organization-recovery refusal are retained. O03.6.3, the parent and O03.7/O03.8 stay open.

historicalUpgrade.interruptedImport: same operation; exact bytes; one acceptance across retries
historicalUpgrade.organizationBootstrap: explicit reviewed mapping; same genesis on retry; private placement; legacy recovery fenced

verification.strategy: Complete PostgreSQL regression and witness/service/reference tests, followed by focused policy/HTTP/current-authority tests for explicit response status additions. Latest passing XML reports retained; no duplicate executions counted as distinct tests.

limitations: O03.6.3 integrated crash/fencing qualification and unchanged O03.6 parent acceptance remain open. Organization replay and restore O03.7/O03.8 remain unavailable; legacy recovery still refuses initialized catalogs.
Local synthetic PostgreSQL/TLS/process evidence does not qualify separate OS accounts, off-host persistence, physical power loss, institutional identity or institutional deployment approval.
No key rotation, barrier release or heuristic resolution of a prepared event absent from a restarted/restored catalog. Uncertain absence stays closed.
Enrollment and runtime admission refuse nondefault guest eligibility/lifecycle and unsupported producers. Full identity/session/sponsorship/retention/hold work remains open.

Full-state authority/checkpoint loading and acknowledgement verification are correctness baselines. The 1 MiB event, 4 MiB checkpoint and 8 MiB wire limits refuse oversize state; institutional scale/performance remains unqualified.

SQL admission is bounded; complete byte-stream and external-worker heartbeat coverage remains F03.4. Privileged database operators are trusted; the service requires a fresh ordinary SQL login after enrollment.
